title: Spectra, resolvents and scattering
description: Spectral measurements, escape, operator domains, reconstruction and long-range limits, with exact models, written proofs and explicit programme prerequisites.
import_policy: Original exposition is CC0. The complete algebra readings are original CC0 exposition. Historical Stacks project excerpts and their notices retain GNU FDL 1.2. The analytic-foundations-for-preparation reading is original CC0 exposition. The coordinate-inverses-and-integration reading is original CC0 exposition. Other linked works retain their own terms.
